coverage.basis: Revenue lines are printed only where a filing states them. A product level split, such as mobile money against data, exists only in an issuer's own revenue note, so it appears for a security whose report has been read page by page and seeded; those are counted below as 'note'. Where the income statement the terminal holds itself splits income into named lines, those lines are shown and their shares computed, counted as 'statement'. Where the filing gives one revenue figure, that is said. Where there is no statement on file, that is said too. The sector paragraph on every security describes an industry and is never a figure.
